length-number-line-skill-01.target: I can solve addition and subtraction word problems about lengths in the same unit.
length-number-line-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can solve addition and subtraction word problems about lengths in the same unit.
length-number-line-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Ignoring units or combining lengths in different units, or adding when a length is cut off. Try this: Draw the lengths on a ruler or bar diagram and label every length with its unit.

length-number-line-skill-02.skill: Whole Numbers on a Number Line
length-number-line-skill-02.target: I can show a whole number as a length from 0 on a number line with equally spaced numbers.
length-number-line-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can show a whole number as a length from 0 on a number line with equally spaced numbers.
length-number-line-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Counting the tick marks instead of the spaces, or starting the count at 1. Try this: Treat the number line as a ruler: count the jumps (spaces) from 0.

length-number-line-skill-03.skill: Adding and Subtracting on a Number Line
length-number-line-skill-03.target: I can show sums and differences within 100 as jumps on a number line.
length-number-line-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can show sums and differences within 100 as jumps on a number line.
length-number-line-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Jumping in the wrong direction for subtraction, or reading the jump length instead of where it lands. Try this: Say where you start, which way you jump, and how far before drawing the arrow.
